text:
marta_g: Hey support — a customer hit a 400 on the rerank endpoint. They copied the cURL from Console and it looks like the candidates payload was serialized as a string, so the server treated candidates as a single string. Error: "invalid input: candidates must be an array of objects". Posting the snippet they used.

liam_s: Can you paste the exact cURL? Console examples sometimes escape JSON for display and that trips people up, especially on macOS/Linux vs PowerShell.

marta_g: Here it is (from customer):

```
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank" \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d "{\"query\":\"best restaurants\",\"candidates\":\"[\\\"{\\\\\\\"id\\\\\\\":1,\\\\\\\"text\\\\\\\":\\\\\\\"A\\\\\\\"}\\\"]\"}"
```

marta_g: They then got back scores all 0 and a separate validation error. They assumed it was a model issue.

support-bot: Automated note: customer_id=acme-inc, request_id=rrk-7643, status=400, server_message="invalid input: candidates must be an array of objects"

devex-eli: Yep that's the classic double-escape problem — Console is showing a JSON blob inside a JSON string for safety, but the copy button gives the escaped form. We should change the copy UI to provide a shell-friendly variant. For now suggest this corrected cURL (bash/zsh):

```
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank" \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"query":"best restaurants","candidates":[{"id":1,"text":"A"}]}'
```

devex-eli: And for PowerShell use double quotes and backtick-escape inner quotes or use a file:

```powershell
$payload = @'{"query":"best restaurants","candidates":[{"id":1,"text":"A"}]}'@
Invoke-RestMethod -Method Post -Uri https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank -Headers @{Authorization = "Bearer $env:REDWOOD_KEY"; "Content-Type" = "application/json"} -Body $payload
```

eng-ml-raj: Thanks for the repro. Two quick things: 1) API should return a clearer error rather than a vague 400 when candidates is a string — happy to add schema validation with a more descriptive message. 2) There's also a limit: we only accept up to 50 candidates for rerank; if a user passes a long stringified array, our parser may silently truncate and that can explain zeroed scores. Can you confirm the customer's candidate count?

marta_g: They sent 72 candidates in the UI experiment. That explains it — they hit the limit. Customer expected automatic truncation to highest-score candidates on our side, but since the payload wasn't parsed as array, the behaviour was weird.

liam_s: Action items: 1) devex-eli — add an explicit bash and PowerShell copy option in Console and a short note about quoting. 2) eng-ml-raj — improve server-side validation to return "400: candidates must be a JSON array of <=50 objects" and avoid silent truncation. 3) support — ping customer with corrected cURL and explain candidate limit + quoting pitfall.

support-bot: Escalation created: #INC-rrk-7643 to eng-ml, priority P2.

devex-eli: I'll draft a small docs patch and include both example cURL variants + a troubleshooting FAQ.

marta_g: I'll reply to customer with the working cURL and recommended change to their test harness. Thanks. :thumbsup:
